description: This source file defines classes and methods related to expression commands in a calculator engine, including command classes for parentheses, unary, binary, and operand commands, with methods for managing command states, tokenization, and visitor pattern acceptance.

classes.name: CParentheses
classes.description: Represents parentheses commands in the expression, holding a command value and providing access to it, as well as command type and visitor acceptance.

classes.name: CUnaryCommand
classes.description: Represents unary commands with one or two command codes, providing methods to set and retrieve commands, command type, and visitor acceptance.

classes.name: CBinaryCommand
classes.description: Represents binary commands with a single command code, providing methods to set and get the command, command type, and visitor acceptance.

classes.name: COpndCommand
classes.description: Represents operand commands, managing a list of command codes, sign, decimal, and scientific notation flags, with methods for tokenization, string conversion, and visitor pattern.

methods.name: GetCommand
methods.description: Returns the command code for CParentheses.

methods.name: GetCommandType
methods.description: Returns the command type for the respective command class.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to perform operations on the command object.

methods.name: SetCommand
methods.description: Sets the command code for CUnaryCommand and CBinaryCommand.

methods.name: GetCommands
methods.description: Returns the list of command codes for CUnaryCommand and COpndCommand.

methods.name: SetCommands
methods.description: Sets the list of command codes for CUnaryCommand and COpndCommand.

methods.name: AppendCommand
methods.description: Appends a command code to the operand command list, handling scientific notation.

methods.name: ToggleSign
methods.description: Toggles the sign of the operand command.

methods.name: RemoveFromEnd
methods.description: Removes the last command code from the operand command list.

methods.name: IsNegative
methods.description: Returns whether the operand command is negative.

methods.name: IsSciFmt
methods.description: Returns whether the operand command is in scientific notation.

methods.name: IsDecimalPresent
methods.description: Returns whether a decimal point is present in the operand command.

methods.name: ClearAllAndAppendCommand
methods.description: Clears all commands and appends a single command code, resetting flags.

methods.name: GetToken
methods.description: Generates a string token representing the operand command, considering decimal, sign, and exponent parts.

methods.name: GetString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the operand's value in a specified radix and precision.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the operand command with a rational value.
